rationale: 候选第二命题截断于『Due to the heterogeneity between LLM 』，其后关键命题缺失：『we propose an offline chain-of-thought evaluation framework, OCEAN, which models chain-of-thought reasoning in LLMs as an MDP』『into inverse propensity scores and propose KG-IPS estimator』『we prove the unbiasedness of the proposed KG-IPS estimator and provide a lower bound on its variance』，框架本体、估计器与理论结论均丢失，E3。
